title: CBPF Contributions 2026
description: Donor-level contributions to UN Country-Based Pooled Funds for fiscal year 2026, covering all CBPFs globally (not Sudan-only — includes funds like Colombia's RhPF-LAC). Each row is one donor's contribution amount and percentage share to a specific pooled fund.

title: CERF Projects 2026_2026-08-12
description: CERF (Central Emergency Response Fund) project allocations for 2026 across all countries and emergency types, including project status, approved amounts, implementing agency, sector, and planned beneficiary breakdowns. Many rows are still Under Review with placeholder values, so filter on allocationStatus or projectStatus before treating figures as final.

title: Sudan - IDP Admin 0_2026-08-13
description: Country-level (admin0) counts of internally displaced people in Sudan by reporting round, with displacement reason and the origin state (admin1) each IDP group fled from. This is the aggregate national figure, not broken down by current location.

title: Sudan - JIAF Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan 2026 — Cluster PIN
description: Admin2-level People in Need (PiN) figures for Sudan's 2026 HRP, broken down by cluster (Health, Nutrition, Education, Food Security, Protection, etc.) alongside total population and population group per location.
source_file: Sudan - JIAF Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan 2026.xlsx

title: Sudan - JIAF Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan 2026 — Cluster Severity
description: Admin2-level sectoral severity scores for Sudan's 2026 HRP, one score per cluster per location, indicating how severe humanitarian needs are in each sector rather than raw need counts.

source_file: Sudan - JIAF Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan 2026.xlsx

title: Sudan - Operational Presence 3W Data January-June 2026
description: Sudan 'Who's doing What Where' (3W) data for Jan–Jun 2026: one row per organization's operational presence in a given state/locality/cluster/month. Locations are plain state and locality names, not P-codes — this is the source that needs the geo crosswalk to join against P-coded sources.

title: Sudan - VIEWS conflict forecasts
description: VIEWS (Violence Early-Warning System) monthly conflict fatality forecasts for Sudan, giving a predicted mean fatality count (main_mean) and a dichotomous conflict/no-conflict indicator (main_dich) per forecast month — this is projected/modeled data, not observed history.
